title: Founder case: Airbnb starts with its founders' own apartment

sources.claim: In 2007 Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia rented air mattresses in their San Francisco apartment to people attending a design conference when hotels were booked; the idea was first called AirBed & Breakfast, and Nathan Blecharczyk joined as a cofounder to build the website.

sections.skill: Apply a documented early decision: test a service with what you already have

questions.intro: Documented history (Wharton/Knowledge at Wharton): In 2007 Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia rented air mattresses in their San Francisco apartment to people attending a design conference when hotels were booked. The idea was first called AirBed & Breakfast, and Nathan Blecharczyk joined as a cofounder to build the website. Lesson drawn by this course (an interpretation): test a service idea first with resources you already have, during a moment of clear demand, before investing heavily. One success story does not guarantee the same result for another business.
